facts.fact: Africa50 says Raya Data Center, owned by Raya Holding, has operated since 2012 as a provider of colocation and cloud services to local and international enterprise customers (dated by the 2024-12-10 release, which gives no other date).

Africa50 says Raya Data Center currently operates two Tier III data centres in Cairo; the stated basis is the release itself, with no certifier named and the facilities not named individually (dated by the 2024-12-10 release).
